notes:
- Updates can no longer get stuck: each new version is saved as its own file and Snap Mixer simply opens the newest one. Nothing in use has to be replaced, so another program holding Snap Mixer's files can't block an update anymore.
- Updates restart Snap Mixer right away, with no helper running in the background.
- If a new version ever fails to open, Snap Mixer goes back to the one that works by itself.
- "Go back to the previous version" keeps working, and going forward again later is instant (no new download).
- Includes everything from 0.9.31: go back to the previous version, Load/Unload buttons under each filament.
